odc_type: Incomplete Serialization Support for Mock Objects
observation_summary: A java.io.NotSerializableException is thrown when attempting to serialize a mock object that was created with both .serializable() and .extraInterfaces() settings.
reasoning_summary: The test fails with a NotSerializableException when attempting to serialize a mock object that has been configured with extra interfaces. The stack trace indicates that the CGLIB-generated proxy class for the mock does not correctly implement the Serializable interface or handle the serialization of the proxy's internal state when additional interfaces are added via the MockSettings API. This suggests that the Mockito framework's proxy generation logic fails to properly propagate the serializable configuration to the underlying proxy class when extra interfaces are present.
